plan: My private value is $23. In a second-price auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid your true value. This means bidding $23 ensures I maximize potential profit - if I win, I'll pay less than my bid, and if I lose, I pay nothing. Since values are independently drawn and this is a single round, I can't learn from past history. I'll aim to bid close to my true value to maximize my chances of a profitable outcome.

Since values are randomly drawn between $0-$49, other bidders might have values higher or lower than mine. I'll bid strategically near my value - not exactly at $18, but slightly below to create a buffer. A bid around $16-$17 gives me a chance to win while protecting potential profit margin.
